seo.title: Local House Restaurant | Camel Burger & Emirati Food in Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
seo.description: Local House, in one of the oldest houses in Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood, Bur Dubai: camel burger, camel biryani, kebab and steak, Emirati breakfast, shakshuka and karak in a courtyard. Open daily 8 AM to 10 PM. 4.5 from 1,260 reviews.

hero.kicker: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood · Bur Dubai
hero.lede: The first Dubai restaurant to put camel on the menu, inside one of Al Fahidi's oldest houses: camel burgers, biryani and kebabs, Emirati breakfast, shakshuka and karak in a shaded courtyard.
